resume: Hi, there! My name is Mirian Moreira and I'm a Full Stack Developer from Latin America. I'm really into Front-end development and I enjoy the challenge of building web designs that are both clean and efficient. My goal is to combine solid coding with good design, always focusing on making interfaces that are straightforward and easy for people to use.
firstLineResumeText: Junior Front-End Developer with 3 years of professional experience in web, mobile, and cross-platform development. Strong foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL, with experience building responsive user interfaces and consuming RESTful APIs.
secondLineResumeText: Demonstrated ability to solve complex bugs, collaborate in agile teams (SCRUM), and contribute to scalable features across multiple platforms (Web, Android, and iOS). Passionate about clean code, inclusive design, and continuous learning.
